name: Intro to Robotics
description: Learners meet the Quarky robot, learn to control its motors and sensors, and build five mini-projects from a line-follower to an obstacle-avoider.

name: Python Foundations
description: A gentle first programming course: variables, loops, functions and a final text-based game project.

name: Computer Vision Basics
description: Learners train simple image classifiers and build a project that reacts to what the camera sees.
requirements: Completion of Python Foundations or equivalent

name: Creative Electronics
description: Hands-on circuits, soldering safety, sensors and actuators — culminating in a self-designed interactive object.
